EPISODE NUMBER: Episode 1
EPISODE LOGLINE: Marta, a lighthouse keeper's daughter, is accused of stealing the family ledger by her brother Owen in front of the whole harbor.
CONTINUITY NOTES: First episode. Establishes Marta, Owen and the missing ledger.

--- SCRIPT START ---

SCENE 01
Scene heading: EXT. HARBOR DOCK – DAY
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 00:40.00

Actions and dialogue:

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:00.00) | End: (00:03.00)
Wide shot of the harbor at dawn.

**OWEN (Furious, Loud):**
Start: (00:01.00) | End: (00:03.50)
"You stole the ledger, Marta!"

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:03.50) | End: (00:05.00)
Owen slaps the ledger out of Marta's hands. It splashes into the water.

**MARTA (Shocked, Whispering):**
Start: (00:05.50) | End: (00:07.50)
"I never touched it."

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:07.50) | End: (00:09.00)
Low string swell.

**OWEN (Cold):**
Start: (00:09.00) | End: (00:11.50)
"Then why is your key in the lock?"

**MARTA (V.O.) (Reflective, Hurt):**
Start: (00:12.00) | End: (00:15.00)
"That key was never mine to lose."

**HARBORMASTER (O.S. / Continues) (Grave):**
Start: (00:15.50) | End: (00:18.00)
"Marta. Come with me. Now."

SCENE 02
Scene heading: INT. LIGHTHOUSE – NIGHT
Scene start: 00:40.00
Scene end: 01:20.00

Actions and dialogue:

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:41.00) | End: (00:44.00)
Marta climbs the spiral stairs, lantern shaking in her hand.

**MARTA (Breathless):**
Start: (00:44.50) | End: (00:47.00)
"Who is up there?"

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:48.00) | End: (00:52.00)
A shadow crosses the lamp room. The ledger lies open on the floor, its last page torn out.

**OWEN (Whispering, Afraid):**
Start: (00:53.00) | End: (00:56.00)
"Don't read it. Please. Whatever you do, don't read the last page."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (01:15.00) | End: (01:20.00)
